revises.note: The original generated record is unchanged and remains the recorded output. Nothing here is re-solved: every number is copied from it.

why: The 0.00441 term was passed to the tool as U_D. It is the spread across three grit treatments, which is a sensitivity to a deliberately changed condition and is not experimental standard uncertainty. Under the corrected eligibility rule it no longer supplies U_D, so U_D joins U_input as an unquantified component.

SA.partial_combination_note: The superseded partial combined U_num with the ineligible treatment spread. With only U_num quantified, the partial combination is U_num itself.
SA.screen: consistency screen for this project, not a universal pass/fail rule

verdict_note: The verdict does not move. It was already INCOMPLETE_UNCERTAINTY because U_input was unquantified; this revision adds a second missing component rather than changing the outcome.
claim_boundary: A0.1 exercises a two-dimensional airfoil workflow at this condition only. It supplies numerical evidence for that workflow and a comparison against published computations. The comparison against the experiment is unresolved. No experimental standard uncertainty is available for this case.
